title: 7 Email Parsing Software Tools and APIs Compared (2026)
summary: Email parsing software compared: Parseur, Mailparser and Zapier pull fields into rows, while Mailgun, Postmark, SendGrid and AgentMail return parsed messages.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


Email parsing software comes in two kinds that share one search term. No-code parsers such as Parseur, Mailparser and Email Parser by Zapier turn recurring business emails into rows of fields, while inbound APIs such as Mailgun, Postmark, SendGrid and AgentMail hand your code the parsed message. Here is what each of the seven returns, how it treats attachments and quoted replies, and what 1,000 emails a month costs.
